After carefully reviewing the code, I've identified that the issue is related to how the expiry check is being performed. It's important to note that the current implementation uses a less-than operator instead of a less-than-or-equal-to operator, which could potentially lead to edge cases where tokens that are exactly at the expiry boundary are incorrectly rejected.
